about: L8 B5 Scoped result-release mutants; runtime tests run in process. The standard mutant runner currently measures compiler suites only; the unit's runtime runner applies each edit in a scratch copy.

mutants.name: L8-B5-scoped-result-lost

mutants.name: L8-B5-scoped-failed-candidate

mutants.name: X5-spawn-path-by-goroutine
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: a task's name is its spawn path, the same in every run of a schedule

mutants.name: X5-deadlock-as-pass
mutants.rule: Explored schedules: no enabled task while tasks remain is a deadlock

mutants.name: X5-live-hook-body

mutants.name: X5-hook-argument-calls

mutants.name: x8-name-no-count
mutants.rule: The k-th handle of one name in a run is named "name (k)".

mutants.name: gx4-member-stays-in-domain
mutants.rule: rt Group (GX4): a member that returned leaves its auto clock's domain.

mutants.name: gx4-member-stays-linked
mutants.rule: rt Group (GX4): a member that returned leaves the task tree.

mutants.name: gx4-group-counted-live
mutants.rule: rt Group (GX4): a group runs nothing, so it is no live member of its clock's domain.

mutants.name: gx5-live-timer-fresh
mutants.rule: rt Sleep (GX5): a live sleep reuses the host timer of an ended one.

mutants.name: bs2-anytext-no-error
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): rt.Text writes an error as fmt's %v does, by its Error method.

mutants.name: bs2-anytext-int
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): rt.Text writes every Go integer kind as fmt's %v does.

mutants.name: bs2-anytext-nil-pointer
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): an Error method that panics on a nil pointer writes <nil>, as fmt does.

mutants.name: bs2-typename-generic
mutants.rule: stdlib.md Types 4 (binsize BS2): rt.TypeName gives reflect's Type.Name, a generic type's name with its arguments.

mutants.name: ert-abort-ignored
mutants.rule: AbortExplore ends the active explored run and frees the explorer, even when a task waits where the scheduler cannot see.

mutants.name: sb8-no-flush-wait
mutants.rule: stdlib.md io 10: a task's wait of the runtime (Done) flushes held standard output.

mutants.name: pace-ignores-user-gogc
mutants.rule: GOGC in the environment turns the heap pacing off: the user's setting wins

mutants.name: pace-floor-above-limit
mutants.rule: A memory limit lowers the floor to a quarter of the limit

mutants.name: pace-never-returns-to-100
mutants.rule: Above the floor the pace is Go's GOGC=100: the goal stays within max(floor, Go's goal)

mutants.name: pace-ignores-roots
mutants.rule: Go's goal scales the stacks and globals with the percent, so the percent accounts for them

mutants.name: pace-ignores-heap-minimum
mutants.rule: Go scales its minimum heap with the percent, so a percent above floor*100/4MiB overshoots the floor

mutants.name: pace-not-rearmed
mutants.rule: The pace is recomputed after every cycle, so a live heap that grows past the floor returns to Go's pace

mutants.name: pace-overrides-program-percent
mutants.rule: A percent the program sets itself wins: the pacer stops

mutants.name: pace-cgroup-leaf-only
mutants.rule: The cgroup limit is the smallest memory.max of the process's cgroup and every cgroup above it

mutants.name: pace-not-started
mutants.rule: Emitted main paces the program's heap

mutants.name: size-hello-cgroup-root-lost
mutants.rule: PACE1: a process in the root cgroup reads the root's memory.max.

mutants.name: size-hello-knob-swapped
mutants.from: func memoryLimit(limit int64) int64 { return setMemoryLimit(limit) }
mutants.to: func memoryLimit(limit int64) int64 { return int64(setGCPercent(int32(limit))) }
mutants.rule: The runtime's knobs bound by name set what runtime/debug reads back.

mutants.name: idle-moves-first-clock
mutants.rule: With several auto clocks armed, the one whose deadline is nearest its own now moves

mutants.name: vsleep-fire-skips-wake
mutants.rule: A fired sleep's timer resumes the sleeper's park word

mutants.name: vsleep-ignores-stop
mutants.rule: A stop ends a sleep on a clock with a domain

mutants.name: vsleep-stop-loses-tie
mutants.rule: Tasks rule 8: a deadline at the instant of the stop ends the sleep as a sleep

mutants.name: park-misses-early-wake
mutants.rule: No lost wake: a park with a wake pending takes it and returns

mutants.name: park-commit-drops-wake
mutants.rule: No lost wake: a wake that comes between park's look and its commit is taken, and the waiter runs on

mutants.name: unpark-drops-pending
mutants.rule: No lost wake: a wake with no sleeper is left for the next park

mutants.name: unpark-skips-sleeper
mutants.rule: A wake reaches a sleeping waiter

mutants.name: stock-park-misses-early-wake
mutants.rule: No lost wake, stock body: a park with a wake pending takes it and returns

mutants.name: stock-unpark-drops-pending
mutants.rule: No lost wake, stock body: a wake with no sleeper is left for the next park

mutants.name: park-reason-renumbered
mutants.rule: The word body names the runtime's waitReasonSyncCondWait

mutants.name: park-trace-reason-renumbered
mutants.rule: The word body names the runtime's traceBlockCondWait

mutants.name: finish-skips-resume
mutants.rule: Join returns the task's exit: the end of a task wakes its owner's Wait

mutants.name: interrupt-skips-resume
mutants.rule: A stop interrupts a task that sleeps on its park word

mutants.name: wait-ignores-stop
mutants.rule: Wait is an interruption point: a stop ends it before the task ends

mutants.name: wait-ignores-ended
mutants.rule: Join returns the task's exit once it ended

mutants.name: carrier-always-goes
mutants.rule: GoOn runs successive children on the carrier's one goroutine

mutants.name: carrier-close-skips-wake
mutants.rule: Close ends the carrier's goroutine

mutants.name: carrier-run-skips-wake
mutants.rule: A child handed to a parked carrier wakes it

mutants.name: sleep-timer-not-reused
mutants.rule: A steady sleep on a test clock reuses the clock's spare timer

mutants.name: timers-pop-reslices
mutants.from:
n := copy(v.timers, v.timers[1:])
	v.timers[n] = nil
	v.timers = v.timers[:n]
mutants.rule: A fire keeps the timer list's room

mutants.name: sleep-timer-stays-fired
mutants.rule: A reused sleep timer starts unfired

mutants.name: fire-reads-task-late
mutants.rule: fire wakes the task it read before it marked the timer fired: the sleeper may hand the timer on once it is marked

mutants.name: wait-hook-slot-stays
mutants.rule: A hook in the slot runs once and leaves it

mutants.name: wait-hook-slot-shadows-map
mutants.rule: Each task's wait runs its own hook

mutants.name: wait-hook-slot-unused
mutants.rule: A hook alone is stored with no allocation

mutants.name: settle-skips-resume
mutants.rule: A member that parks or leaves wakes every Settle that waits

mutants.name: settles-not-bumped
mutants.rule: A woken Settle sees that a member parked or left

mutants.name: settle-stop-ignored
mutants.rule: A stop of its caller ends a Settle with Interrupted

mutants.name: restart-never-reuses
mutants.rule: A child restarts in its last handle once that handle's job returned on the carrier

mutants.name: restart-ignores-running
mutants.rule: A handle whose job still runs on the carrier is not reused

mutants.name: alone-spawn-keeps
mutants.rule: rt.Alone: starting a task ends Alone before the task's goroutine exists, so a Ref locks from then on

mutants.name: alone-group-keeps
mutants.from: Spread() // its members run on goroutines the host starts (alone.go)
mutants.rule: rt.Alone: making a group ends Alone, since host goroutines run its members

mutants.name: alone-carrier-keeps
mutants.from: Spread() // before the job reaches another goroutine (alone.go; I-FLIP: REF-ALONE x PARK's carrier)
mutants.rule: rt.Alone: a child started on a carrier ends Alone before its job reaches the carrier's goroutine

mutants.name: second-clock-leaves-domain
mutants.from:
if m := t.member.Load(); m != nil {
		d := m.d
mutants.rule: A clock that a member makes joins its domain; the maker stays a member, so an auto clock made before it still moves

mutants.name: rt-afterdrop-returned-ignored
mutants.rule: runtime.md Timeouts 4: a body that returned its value before the deadline's stop ended it gives that value, not Expired

mutants.name: rt-afterdrop-kept-not-set
mutants.rule: runtime.md Timeouts 4: the value After gives is the one the body returned

mutants.name: virtual-alarm-never-runs
mutants.rule: A virtual AfterFunc runs its function when the clock reaches its deadline, as NewTimer's channel delivers.

mutants.name: virtual-alarm-now-never-runs
mutants.rule: A virtual AfterFunc of a span of zero or less starts its function at once.

mutants.name: c4-check-unpolled
mutants.rule: Check is an interruption point, so it runs a WhenPolled hook: a handler that only Checks is watched, and a client that leaves stops it.

mutants.name: c4-stopped-unpolled
mutants.rule: Stopped is an interruption point, so it runs a WhenPolled hook.

mutants.name: c4-done-unpolled
mutants.rule: A wait (Done) is an interruption point, so it runs a WhenPolled hook: a handler that waits is watched.

mutants.name: c5-poll-hook-allocates
mutants.rule: Arming a poll hook allocates nothing: it lives in the caller's PollHook.

mutants.name: c5-poll-hook-lost
mutants.rule: The interruption point that finds the poll flag runs the armed hook.

mutants.name: virtual-settle-ignores-alarms
mutants.rule: runtime.md Timeouts 11: a Settle waits for the alarm functions it started, so a member an alarm wakes runs before the time moves on.

mutants.name: park-commit-drops-parker
mutants.rule: A second goroutine that parks on a word one sleeps on fails loudly (parkTwice); the sleeper is never dropped.

mutants.name: stock-park-drops-parker
mutants.rule: A second goroutine that parks on a word one sleeps on fails loudly (parkTwice); the sleeper is never dropped.

mutants.name: waiter-stop-skips-slot

mutants.name: waiter-stop-skips-more
mutants.rule: runtime.md Tasks: a stop ends every wait of the task, two goroutines' waits on one task too.

mutants.name: bs2-other-text-unknown
mutants.rule: binsize BS2: rt.Text writes a value of any other Go type as Go's runtime writes a panic of it, (T) 0xADDR, without fmt.

mutants.name: stop-claim-always-first
mutants.rule: runtime.md Tasks 11: a Task has one waiter; a second task that waits on a handle another task waits on is a defect.
